The irony behind all this is that Medicare doesn' t cover any dental procedures, even though dentists emphasize how bad teeth can cause illness in other, internal parts of the body. For example, a research team from Columbia University' s School of Public Health released the results of a three-year study of 420 men and women, concluding that the
improvement of gum health can help slow the development of atherosclerosis, the build-up of cholesterol-rich plaque along artery walls, which can lead to heart attacks and strokes.
